role: Exploratory full-graph reference within the Gandalf sampling and ULTRA pilot study

result_provenance.source: Exact verified execution outputs reported in this conversation, retained after completion at user request
result_provenance.record_type: Protocol and aggregate results; not a raw inference artifact archive
result_provenance.reason_raw_outputs_absent: Temporary files and GPU caches were deleted at user request before the experiment was selected for retention
result_provenance.disease_to_drug_reused: Aggregate from the immediately preceding verified temporary 3g head-prediction run; no rescoring during the reverse-direction run

graph.prepared_config_note: Existing preparation config names 4g; these reference runs reused its frozen graph and split but explicitly loaded the 3g checkpoint

evaluation.split_method: Sort unique CURIE pairs, shuffle with random.Random(731), allocate floor(0.8*N) visible, floor(0.1*N) validation, remainder test
evaluation.masking: Remove every direct connection between validation/test pairs, all predicates and both directions, before inverse augmentation and relation-graph construction
evaluation.filtering: Exclude other known explicit Drug-Disease treats answers across all splits from ranking competitors; do not restore held-out graph edges
evaluation.combined_weighting: Equal weighting of both directions: 3618 directional predictions over 1809 unique pairs
evaluation.metric_units: MRR and Hits@k are fractions on [0,1]; Hits@k are not percentages

execution.timing_note: GPU inference timings include synchronization; elapsed runs also include setup and batching checks. Existing relation graph was reused, not rebuilt.

Exact test-pair coverage and all aggregate metrics verified; combined arithmetic verified
limitations: Raw scores, per-pair ranks, and temporary runners are no longer available; this record cannot independently reproduce those original outputs

Test results were already inspected; further comparisons are exploratory, not a new confirmatory evaluation
